title: Polyploid newt kidney tubules are built by one giant cell instead of eight to ten

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Polyploid newt kidney tubules are built by one giant cell instead of eight to ten

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: In polyploid newts, whose cells are enlarged by extra genome copies, kidney tubules normally made by eight to ten communicating cells are instead formed by a single enormous cell wrapping around itself, so a different molecular mechanism (cytoskeletal bending rather than cell–cell communication) is deployed to reach the same anatomical outcome, an instance of downward causation in the service of a large-scale anatomical goal.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Darwin's agential materials: evolutionary implications of multiscale competency in developmental biology

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Levin M 2023, Darwin's agential materials: evolutionary implications of multiscale competency in developmental biology › Morphogenetic control as a collective intelligence

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: In the kidney system of polyploid newts, the normal cell:cell communication that creates a tubule from eight to ten cells working together is swapped for a single enormous cell that wraps around itself to create the same final outcome [184].

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Levin M, “Darwin's agential materials: evolutionary implications of multiscale competency in developmental biology”, Cellular and molecular life sciences : CMLS (2023), doi:10.1007/s00018-023-04790-z; section “Morphogenetic control as a collective intelligence”. Scope: Polyploid newt pronephric/kidney tubules

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2023-agential-09: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.64

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Cell number and tubule construction are direct image-derived variables. The empirical anatomy is resolvable if source images exist, but current public coverage is uncertain and the goal-directed interpretation is not discriminated by morphology alone.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Reanalyze histological serial sections or microscopy of diploid and polyploid newt pronephric tubules to count contributing cells, trace cell boundaries, and quantify whether a single giant cell wraps to form the lumen. The anatomical result is refuted if multiple cell membranes consistently form the tubule.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
The underlying historical microscopy may not be digitized or public.

Downward causation is an interpretation beyond the anatomical observation.

Cell-boundary reconstruction requires adequate serial resolution.

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Cell number and lumen closure are measurable, and the classical newt literature reports them for this organ. There is no public image set from which the counts can be redone, so coverage is the published descriptions of one system. The goal-directed and downward-causation reading is not separated by those sections from a passive geometric consequence of enlarged cells.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: In polyploid newt kidney tubules, count cells per cross-section, cell size, and whether a single cell closes the lumen, compared with diploid tubules that use about eight to ten cells. A shift from a multicellular tube to one wrapped cell at higher ploidy would support the anatomical report; persistent multicellular tubes despite giant cells would refute it.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
The observations are mid-twentieth-century histological accounts, not a digital image archive.

Downward causation and the choice of cytoskeletal bending over cell-cell communication are interpretations of the same sections.
